# doc_picker_plugin
Custom Cordova plugin to use the iOS DocumentPickerViewController to gain access to Box folders.

To install this plugin use the following command:

     cordova plugin add git+ssh://git@github.build.ge.com:iacquire-grc/doc_picker_plugin.git

You may have to set your proxy settings in your environment because Cordova may try to reach outside the GE network when updating the plugins.  You may also be prompted to enter your GitHub password up to 3 times.
